messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty: Observability gap detected. Multiple metric streams to Datadog failing to ingest. Triggered at 11:13 PDT. Paging oncall.
sara (SRE): ack. joining. Quick check: are traces/rum still coming in?
dan (oncall): traces ok, RUM ok. Only metrics POSTs to api.datadoghq.com returning 429s and occasional 502s. Seeing large spike in cardinality errors too.
sara (SRE): interesting — we shipped a metrics tagging change in today's release that increased tag cardinality for auth-service.
priya (platform): yep, deploy-bot shows the rollout. deploy-bot: deploy completed: release/2026-03-15-auth-tags @ 10:58 PDT (canary->50%).
megan (Customer Success): Customer X and Y reported blanked billing graphs. They asked if this is related to our release.
dan (oncall): likely linked. Plan: 1) mark incident as third-party (Datadog ingest) 2) pause high-cardinality metrics export from forwarder 3) enable log-derived fallback metrics 4) silence noisy alerts 5) notify customers.
ops-bot: Running alert silence: metrics/* -> 90m by dan
ops-bot: Silence applied: metrics-host-* , metrics-app-errors
sara (SRE): priya / dan — can we hotfix forwarder to drop new tags for auth-service? We should avoid redeploy if possible.
priya (platform): yes. Pushing a config patch to statsd-forwarder to strip tag "env.instance_id" for auth-service only.
priya (platform): command: ```bash
kubectl -n infra patch configmap/statsd-forwarder --type=json -p='[{"op":"add","path":"/strip_tags/auth-service","value":["env.instance_id"]}]'
```
priya (platform): rolling to 10% canary now.
dan (oncall): putting synthetic monitors up that report to internal prometheus so customer-facing alerts still function.
sara (SRE): create pushgateway flow: extract nginx access logs and emit counts. Priya, can you flip dashboards to read fallback metrics?
priya (platform): done. Dashboards flagged to prefer fallback when dd.* missing; small panel-level override.
megan (Customer Success): messaging to customers: "We are investigating missing metrics displayed in dashboards. Root cause appears to be rate-limiting at Datadog exacerbated by a recent change increasing metric cardinality. We're rolling a temporary mitigation and will follow up." Sending now.
datadog-bot: Datadog status: Investigating partial ingestion delays. Known issue with high-cardinality bursts impacting the ingest pipeline. https://status.datadoghq.com/incident/ingest-xyz
sara (SRE): treated as upstream. Also enabling client-side batching/backoff so we do not thundering herd.
priya (platform): patch to forwarder client: set backoff exponential with max retries 5. Deploying via configmap reload.
ops-bot: Backoff config rolled out to 25% canary
dan (oncall): collecting impact samples and ticket ids. Megan drop CS IDs here.
megan (Customer Success): CS-5012, CS-5021 — both flagged missing billing metrics.
sara (SRE): creating incident record INC-2026-133. Owners: sara, dan. Shortlink: https://redwood.internal/inc/INC-2026-133
ops-bot: Incident INC-2026-133 created and linked.
priya (platform): can confirm the tag-strip canary reduced cardinality and outbound 429s for the canary pods. If trend holds will ramp.
dan (oncall): 429s dropping from ~1200/min to ~80/min in the last 6m. Datadog backpressure easing.
datadog-bot: Update: ingestion backlog detected; teams working on normalization/backfill. No ETA.
sara (SRE): note for handoff: if Datadog backfills, timestamps may be normalized; dashboards could show spikes when backfilled. We'll annotate customer tickets.
megan (Customer Success): noted. I'll tell customers to expect possible backfilled spikes and to reopen tickets if gaps persist >24h.
priya (platform): ramping tag-strip to 100% now.
ops-bot: Alert silence extended 1h per sara (now total 2.5h)
dan (oncall): prepping handoff: I'm on until 20:30 PDT. Sara will cover overnight after that. Leave silence and pushgateway fallback in place.
sara (SRE): leaving detailed notes in INC-2026-133: root cause = Datadog ingestion rate limiting exacerbated by release-led high-cardinality metrics; mitigations = strip high-card tags, apply client backoff, log-derived fallback metrics, customer notifications.
priya (platform): filing follow-up RFC: require CI checks on tag cardinality and an optional dual-sink for critical telemetry (PROD-2045).
ops-bot: Handoff recorded: dan -> sara at 20:30 PDT. Handoff note attached to incident record.
dan (oncall): last update before handoff: metrics largely returning, synth monitors reporting OK, customers notified. Closing active pager but keeping incident open for backfill monitoring.
sara (SRE): thanks team. Will watch next 4h for any regressions. If Datadog re-applies rate-limits we will roll back the release and open a postmortem. :white_check_mark:
